mapper.insert: insert into ai_message_feedback ( message_id, user_id, helpful, reason ) values ( #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{helpful}, #{reason} ) on duplicate key update helpful = values(helpful), reason = values(reason), updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select id, message_id, user_id, helpful, reason, created_at, updated_at from ai_message_feedback where user_id = #{userId} and message_id = #{messageId}

select feedback.id, feedback.message_id, feedback.user_id, feedback.helpful, feedback.reason, feedback.created_at, feedback.updated_at from ai_message_feedback feedback inner join ai_messages message on message.id = feedback.message_id where feedback.user_id = #{userId} and message.conversation_id = #{conversationId}

select feedback.id, feedback.message_id, feedback.helpful, feedback.reason, feedback.created_at, feedback.updated_at, resolution.resolution_note, resolution.document_id as resolved_document_id, resolution.resolved_at, assistant.content as answer_content, account.username, account.nickname, ( select user_message.content from ai_messages user_message where user_message.conversation_id = assistant.conversation_id and user_message.role = 'user' and user_message.id < assistant.id order by user_message.id desc limit 1 ) as question_content from ai_message_feedback feedback inner join ai_messages assistant on assistant.id = feedback.message_id inner join ai_conversations conversation on conversation.id = assistant.conversation_id inner join users account on account.id = feedback.user_id left join ai_feedback_resolutions resolution on resolution.feedback_id = feedback.id and resolution.resolved_at >= feedback.updated_at where account.school_id = #{schoolId} and conversation.user_id = feedback.user_id order by feedback.helpful asc, feedback.updated_at desc limit 100

select feedback.id, feedback.message_id, feedback.helpful, feedback.reason, feedback.created_at, feedback.updated_at, resolution.resolution_note, resolution.document_id as resolved_document_id, resolution.resolved_at from ai_message_feedback feedback inner join ai_messages message on message.id = feedback.message_id inner join ai_conversations conversation on conversation.id = message.conversation_id inner join users account on account.id = feedback.user_id left join ai_feedback_resolutions resolution on resolution.feedback_id = feedback.id where feedback.id = #{feedbackId} and account.school_id = #{schoolId} and conversation.user_id = feedback.user_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ai_feedback_resolutions (feedback_id, reviewer_id, document_id, resolution_note) values (#{feedbackId}, #{reviewerId}, #{documentId}, #{note}) on duplicate key update reviewer_id = values(reviewer_id), document_id = values(document_id), resolution_note = values(resolution_note), resolved_at = current_timestamp
